scope: Four pendants, four gem components, opal brooch and five raw gemstones; each original material image and identity retained.
dimensions_note: Presentation coordinates trace existing 128-pixel images. Depth/tessellation are art controls, not physical or balance values. Uniform fitting stays within the original opaque width/height; native Actor.Scale .25 and collision stay unchanged.
modularity: Separate closed settings, raised stones, chains, scrolls and crystal/matrix components; world props, not worn fitting.
projection_note: Original painted pixels project over closed faceted volumes, including crystal and matrix backs. Smaller internal undercoats sample original alpha >=250/255 across a 3x3 neighborhood; source fractional alpha is preserved. Jewelry backs retain owned metal materials and ring interiors are open geometry.
